cover.title: AELab25 Modern UI Overview
cover.description: Current capabilities across PSS/E, TARA, PSCAD and Utilities. Source-verified feature updates lead this edition; an expanded, clearly labeled archive of 55 UI captures follows. Cover image: archived interface reference.

slides.title: Current workspace map
slides.description: The searchable tool rail now spans four platforms. PSS/E has a dedicated Load Modeling section; PSCAD has its own Model Preparation workspace.
bullets: PSS/E | Steady-state and dynamic analysis; automation, model QA and results.
PSS/E Load Modeling | Composite Load Models (CMLD), PERC1 and PERC2.
TARA | Result visualization, INCH case preparation, study setup and result review.
PSCAD | Model Preparation > One-Line to PSCAD review prototype.
Utilities | Steady State Contingency and Dynamic Stability Contingency.
Utilities | TPIT and Grid Map remain available alongside the contingency tools.

slides.title: What has expanded since the previous overview
slides.description: The published 47-page edition covered 45 archived screens. This update adds the current feature guide and the ten additional TARA screens in the source catalog.
bullets: Study management | Saved ACCC setups and evidence; connected Dynamic Simulator studies, event selection, dashboard and history.
Model preparation | CMLD, PERC1/PERC2, the PSCAD review prototype, richer equipment IDV authoring and dynamic event preparation.
Review and reporting | ACCC input checks and audits; TARA native imports, SCD planning, summaries, cross-case plots and mitigation registers.

slides.title: ACCC: saved studies and preflight checks
slides.description: Study setup, execution evidence and recorded results now have separate lifecycles. Reviewing a previous run does not replace the current editable setup.
bullets: Save setup, Save as new and Load setup manage named configurations. Run history reopens recorded results and their submitted settings.
Check inputs reviews files, deck structure, subsystem references and numeric settings. Native DFAX check builds DFAX in a fresh worker without running ACCC.
Run manifests retain case identities, input hashes, criteria, runtime and output paths. Unsupported input syntax and native failures remain visible for review.

slides.title: ACCC: assessment completeness and audit reports
slides.description: Run Summary and Contingency Audit expose the evidence behind violation tables, including nonconvergence, absent records and voltage extrema.
bullets: Explicit convergence and uniquely identified base-case evidence govern comparisons. Missing ratings or voltage evidence are unavailable, never substituted with zero.
Submitted/returned contingency coverage, evaluated voltage counts and zero-voltage observations are retained. Zero voltage remains visible and requires review.
Excel/CSV reports distinguish complete assessments with no violations from incomplete evidence. Native PSS/E report criteria can differ from AELab's recorded assessment.

slides.title: Dynamic Simulator: connected study workspaces
slides.breadcrumb: PSS/E > Analysis > Dynamic Stability Analysis > Dynamic Simulator
slides.description: Studies, Setup, Contingencies, Run dashboard and Study history organize the full workflow, with live console and files/plotting views also available.
bullets: Named studies support save, duplicate, import/export and restoration. Previews show settings, notes and checked events before opening a study.
Searchable Run checkboxes preserve hidden selections. Highlighting an event is separate from selecting it for execution; Run selected includes all checked events.
The dashboard combines live execution status with event details. History reopens recorded settings and evidence; automatic refresh stays on the dashboard. One study runs at a time.

slides.title: Dynamic Simulator: event evidence and run controls
slides.breadcrumb: Run dashboard > Summary / Channels / Losses / Plots / Attempts / Logs / Setup
slides.description: Execution outcome and engineering assessment remain separate. Event-level evidence supports investigation of completed, failed and retried attempts.
bullets: Review full-resolution channel extrema and times, voltage evidence and separate connectivity, equipment-loss and relay-shedding measures. Missing evidence remains explicit.
Embedded previews and interactive plots use recorded artifacts. Preview samples may be decimated; reported extrema come from full-resolution assessment, and FREQ is not automatically Hz.

Isolated workers support concurrency, per-attempt timeout, retries and optional crash reruns with recorded settings. Failed attempts remain available; engineering FAIL/REVIEW is not automatically retried.

slides.title: Composite Load Models (CMLD)
slides.breadcrumb: PSS/E > Load Modeling > Composite Load Models (CMLD)
slides.description: A guided workspace wraps source inspection, database preparation and reviewed legacy CMLD DYR generation, with dedicated source, output and log views.
bullets: Create a blank workbook or inspect Excel/SQLite inputs. Validate schema, values and assignments, then create a canonical database snapshot without PSS/E.
Save/load setups and select an explicit runtime, SAV and generation settings. Generate DYR uses an isolated licensed Windows PSS/E process and retains logs, manifests and hashes.
New setups default to PSS/E 35.6. Version guidance is explicit; structural checks and generated records do not validate model suitability, initialization or legacy-to-modular conversion.

slides.title: PERC1 and PERC2 preparation workspaces
slides.description: Separate model drafts organize study context, reference parameters, facility allocation, vendor DYR templates, research limits and review logs.
bullets: Record explicit MW/Mvar allocations and inspect reference worksheets. Save/load each model's draft independently; reference exports are labeled REFERENCE_ONLY.
Reviewed vendor-template replication changes bus/load identity while retaining the supplied model parameters. Worksheet values are not silently serialized into a guessed DYR schema.
The app defaults to PERC1 36.5 and provisional PERC2 36.7 targets. PERC2 availability remains UNCONFIRMED; templates, installed libraries and model behavior require separate verification.

slides.title: One-Line to PSCAD: local review prototype
slides.breadcrumb: PSCAD > Model Preparation > One-Line to PSCAD
slides.description: Import a PDF or image, inspect the interpreted drawing and explicitly review equipment, values, units and connectivity before preparing exports.
bullets: Drawing overlays, equipment/parameter editors, connectivity and issue review retain source identity and correction history. Missing data remain unresolved rather than receiving invented defaults.
Save/load JSON and export a REVIEW_ONLY bundle without PSCAD. Review release-specific mappings before preparing a Windows build bundle for the configured PSCAD 5.1.0 target.

Recognition supports a narrow local baseline and optional OCR. This is not a verified turnkey drawing-to-EMT converter; licensed project creation, compilation and engineering validation are separate stages.

slides.title: IDV Generator: equipment projects and full-file editing
slides.description: Build a change and Edit an existing IDV now support complementary authoring workflows. Generation produces reviewed command text; it does not execute a case.
bullets: Built-in line, autotransformer, shunt and bus templates expose editable engineering defaults. Combine equipment changes in an ordered project and save/reload its configuration.
The persistent conductor/rating library supports explicit mappings. Line previews distinguish conductor ratings from the separately entered substation equipment limit and show the conversion.
The complete-file editor retains command order, comments and unedited recording content. Edit labeled commands or full text, then save under a new name for independent case review.

slides.title: Batch Changes and Model QA: isolated execution
slides.breadcrumb: PSS/E > Automation & QA > Apply Batch Changes / Model QA & Validation
slides.description: The batch interface separates Setup & Plan, Case Outputs and Run Log, while retaining visible run/cancel controls and explicit per-case change ordering.
bullets: Assign ordered IDV/Python changes to selected cases and review derived outputs. Case Outputs fills when the batch finishes; Run Log shows progress during execution.
QA and Batch Changes run in separate owned worker processes. Cancellation targets the selected process tree; shutdown failures and partial outputs remain visible.
These jobs have no automatic elapsed-time cutoff. Process liveness is not numerical progress, and successful process completion does not turn failed QA checks into passes.

slides.title: TARA: contingency profiles and SCD planning
slides.description: Study planning now offers finer contingency-family selection, explicit event roles and frozen plan review before isolated TARA execution.
bullets: Select N-1 families P1s, P2s, P4s, P5s and P7s independently, alongside P3/P6/ERCOT2/ERCOT3 N-1-1 mappings. Review case, deck and output assignments before running.
Export separate N-1/N-1-1 TARAViewer batch CSVs and printable plans. SCD planning retains explicit Options files, subsystem choices and load-eligibility selections.
Generation-side/no-load-adjustment and load-enabled SCD variants remain distinct. Reported execution is not correction approval; SCD engineering outcome remains NOT_EVALUATED.

slides.title: TARA: native results, summaries and comparisons
slides.breadcrumb: TARA > Results > Steady State Analysis Results
slides.description: Native N-1 and N-1-1/SCD imports join the combined-workbook workflow, with traceable result views and exports for engineering review.
bullets: Worst Thermal and Worst Voltage retain reported element/event identity, source rows and distinct reported-contingency counts. These counts do not establish execution coverage.
Detailed Thermal/Voltage Cross-Case and compact Summary tables preserve case context and source limits. Missing values and status text are not converted to zero.
Export updated workbooks and self-contained HTML thermal/voltage plot reports. Native source-selection policy and SCD adjustment context remain explicit in the evidence.

slides.title: TARA: mitigation register preparation
slides.description: Direct native N-1 and N-1-1 workbooks can feed an auditable Excel register for reviewing candidate mitigation work.
bullets: Combine reported thermal and voltage issues into a review template while retaining source workbook, source-row and hash evidence.
Editable CAP/action fields support engineering disposition. Policy-review information accompanies the generated register rather than silently approving a response.
A register entry or plotted violation is a review aid. It does not establish an accepted mitigation, contingency coverage, study compliance or successful corrective operation.

slides.title: Dynamic contingencies: Audit & Split and Auto CONs
slides.description: The newer event-preparation tabs extend the original DWG setup/build workflow with searchable event evidence, cut-ins and reviewed template reconstruction.
bullets: Audit executable bus references in IDV folders, loose files and ZIPs. Preview/export selected events; prepare two-sided line cut-ins and batch mappings from Excel/CSV.
Audit & Split retains manifests and recovery archives. Default replacement removes selected originals from the active folder only after verification; Keep originals selects copies-only behavior.
Audit & Split > Rebuild from DWG reuses reviewed event templates. Auto CONs prepares P1 source CONs from SINGLE rules and paired CON decks from selected sources.

slides.title: Dynamic contingencies: pairing and equipment inputs
slides.breadcrumb: Utilities > Dynamic Stability Contingency > Pair event IDVs / Equipment IDVs
slides.description: Two additional preparation routes assemble candidate event scripts with explicit inputs, previewable text and export evidence.
bullets: Pair event IDVs combines ordered first-outage and second-event sources for P3/P6/ERCOT2/ERCOT3 candidates. Preview scripts and export selected pairs with hashes and assumptions.
Equipment IDVs accepts pasted bus, AC-line, transformer and machine tables to prepare P1/P3/P6/ERCOT2/ERCOT3 batches. Advanced exact templates and full-script previews remain available.
Generated category names do not establish compliance, complete topology coverage or an adjusted initial case. Review event actions, timing and case assumptions before licensed simulation.

slides.title: Screenshot reference: 55 archived application views
slides.breadcrumb: Reference atlas | PSS/E, TARA and Utilities captures
slides.description: The following pages preserve the established screen guide and add ten TARA catalog views missing from the previous portfolio PDF. These are archived captures, not fresh October screenshots.
bullets: The atlas covers analysis, automation, result review, INCH preparation, contingency utilities, TPIT and Grid Map. Added TARA pages cover SCD, Worst/native results and cross-case/summary views.
Load Modeling, PSCAD and the expanded Dynamic Simulator dashboard are documented in the preceding source-based feature pages; the archived catalog has no captures of those new layouts.
Blank tables and synthetic labels are intentional. Captures do not represent licensed study validation. Source revision, content and image hashes are recorded in docs/aelab-overview.json.

psse-steady-state-analysis.description: Archived ACCC setup with case, contingency, solver and reporting controls. The current workflow adds saved studies, input/DFAX checks, history and assessment audit reports; see the feature guide.

psse-dynamic-simulator.description: Archived prepared-case IDV batch setup. The current Dynamic Simulator adds connected study tabs, searchable Run checkboxes, event-detail dashboards and recorded history; see the feature guide.

psse-idv-generator.description: Archived line-oriented IDV authoring form. The current generator adds equipment templates, editable defaults, ordered projects, conductor/rating libraries and complete-file editing; see the feature guide.

psse-apply-batch-changes.description: Archived stacked batch form for ordered case changes. The current tool separates Setup & Plan, Case Outputs and Run Log, with persistent controls and isolated worker execution.

psse-model-qa-validation.description: Case scope and deterministic model checks. This archived setup predates the newer owned-worker isolation and cancellation behavior. Review findings separately from process completion.

utilities-dwg-setup.description: Archived DWG source/setup workspace. Current navigation also includes Audit & Split, Auto CONs, Pair event IDVs and Equipment IDVs; their source-verified capabilities appear in the feature guide.

tara-scd-setup-run.description: Review separate SCD plans for generation adjustments and P6 load-enabled policies, with explicit Options files and engineer-selected load eligibility.

tara-results-native-n1.description: Import native N-1 workbooks with explicit source-pair selection. Direct BranchViol/VoltViol is preferred; cross-comparison results follow their Primary-row policy. Retain source decisions and reported-row provenance.

tara-steady-state-setup-run.description: Archived RAW/deck mapping and run setup. Current selection separates P1s, P2s, P4s, P5s and P7s N-1 families alongside the N-1-1 mappings. Review the frozen plan before execution.
